mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_vector_cleanup (vector_id, tenant_id, knowledge_id, file_id, chunk_public_id) VALUES (#{vectorId}, #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeId}, #{fileId}, #{chunkPublicId}) ON CONFLICT (vector_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT q.* FROM chunk_vector_cleanup q WHERE q.state = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_chunk dc WHERE (dc.status = 2 AND dc.vector_id = q.vector_id) OR dc.pending_vector_id = q.vector_id ) ORDER BY q.create_time, q.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE chunk_vector_cleanup q SET state = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE q.vector_id = #{vectorId} AND q.state = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_chunk dc WHERE (dc.status = 2 AND dc.vector_id = q.vector_id) OR dc.pending_vector_id = q.vector_id )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunk_vector_cleanup WHERE vector_id = #{vectorId} AND state = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_chunk dc WHERE (dc.status = 2 AND dc.vector_id = chunk_vector_cleanup.vector_id) OR dc.pending_vector_id = chunk_vector_cleanup.vector_id )
mapper.update: UPDATE chunk_vector_cleanup SET state = 0, retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 500), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE vector_id = #{vectorId} AND state = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chunk_vector_cleanup q WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_chunk dc WHERE dc.status = 2 AND dc.vector_id = q.vector_id )
mapper.update: UPDATE chunk_vector_cleanup SET state = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE state = 1 AND update_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 minute'
